import cv2
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.datasets import mnist

def train(model):
    (images, labels), _ = mnist.load_data()
    mask = (labels == 0) | (labels == 1)
    images, labels = images[mask], labels[mask]
    images = tf.image.resize(images[..., None].astype(np.float32) / 255.0, (20, 20))
    model.fit(images, labels, validation_split=0.2, epochs=3)

def predict(model, frame):
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    binary = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV, 11, 2)
    dilated = cv2.dilate(binary, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=1)
    image = cv2.resize(dilated, (20, 20)).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
    return model.predict(image.reshape(1, 20, 20, 1), verbose=0)
